en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2327 - Abdullah ibn Sinan asked Abu Abdullah (as) about the words of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic:
"And whoever enters it shall be safe."

(Surah Aal-e-Imran 3:97)
Imam (as) replied: "Whoever enters the sanctuary (Haram) seeking refuge is safe from the wrath of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic. Likewise, any wild animal or bird that enters it is safe from being disturbed or harmed until it leaves the sanctuary."
